fieldValues.title: Decide: the right owner settles what governs later work
fieldValues.purpose: Choices that govern later choices are made at the right level by the right owner, in a form they can judge, recorded once and cited, never asked again.
fieldValues.in_scope: Decisions and their kinds, modes, doors and cells; proposals, sessions and ratification; the affirmation layer; ADRs.
fieldValues.out_of_scope: The work the decisions govern; recording what happened (Learn and remember).
